title: Coherence retained by the natural total tensor pullback comparison
statement: For a morphism f:X→Y of schemes in universe u, commutative ring sheaves R on Y_proet and R′ on X_proet in universe u+1 and an identification f⁻¹R≅R′ as in [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-tensor-descent-data], let L be the identified ordinary module pullback. There exists a natural total comparison e:T′(L−,L−)≅L(T(−,−)) whose inverse components equal the specified proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso inverse. For any three complexes and any source and target model associators satisfying the pure-triple generator formulas of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], the inverse natural comparison satisfies L(a);e⁻¹(P,T(Q,N));T′(1,e⁻¹(Q,N)) = e⁻¹(T(P,Q),N);T′(e⁻¹(P,Q),1);a′. No derived-category or flatness hypotheses are used.

source.place: Tags 03EL, 07A4 and 06YN: natural pullback tensor comparisons and signed total tensor summands.

proof.text: Take the existing natural total comparison, retaining its specified inverse components. Normalize every homogeneous summand by the geometric total-generator equation. Form the natural ordinary tensor comparison, use ordinary associativity to obtain its inverse associativity equation, and apply the general summand-normalized ringed chain comparison theorem to each supplied source and target pure-triple model associator. The resulting equality is exactly the inverse-comparison associativity equation.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleCoherentTotalTensorPullbackComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R' : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ R') :
    let L := proEtaleRingModulePullback f R R' c
    ∃ e : ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
        (L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) R' ≅
      coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) R ⋙
        L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ),
      (∀ P Q, e.inv.app (P, Q) = (proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f R R' c P Q).inv) ∧
      RingedTensorComparisonCoherence.{u + 1, u, u, u + 1, u, u}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) R (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) R' L e.symm
